You thrust your shield into the blow. Ice bursts from its rim and drives the attacker back.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before a defense roll against a shield-blockable attack from an adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a held shield. Grants one ordinary shield, Bulk 1, if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Defense / Control

Gain 1 Boon to this defense. After the attack resolves, on a Strong defense push the attacker 2 squares directly away from you. Use the existing defense roll; Stability applies. This is not an additional use of Shield Block.
